info.name: univ-v2-timetable
info.description:
Timetable APIs only (current BE).

## Flow
1. `POST /timeTable` — structure template (no course/session/dates)
2. `POST /timeTable/courseMapping` — get `timetableStructureCourseMapperId`
3. `POST /timeTableCreate/` — routine under mapperId
4. `POST /timeTableCreate/mapping` — grid cells
5. `PATCH /timeTableCreate/publish`

Print/table list: `GET /timeTable/structureMappings`

Set `baseurl` + `token` before calling.

item.name: time table
item.description:
Structure (`/timeTable`) + routine (`/timeTableCreate`).

`sessionId` lives only on course mapping, not on structure.

item.name: structure (/timeTable)
item.description:
| Method | Path | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| POST | `/timeTable` | Create structure + periods |
| GET | `/timeTable` | List structures + `courseMappings[]` |
| GET | `/timeTable/structureMappings` | Flat print/table rows |
| GET | `/timeTable/single` | One structure by id |
| POST | `/timeTable/courseMapping` | Map course + session + dates |
| PATCH | `/timeTable/structure` | Update mapping by mapper id |
| POST | `/timeTable/period` | Add period |
| PATCH | `/timeTable` | Update period rows |
| DELETE | `/timeTable` | Delete one period |

No `DELETE /timeTable/structure`.

request.description:
**POST /timeTable**

Creates structure template only. Do **not** send `courseId`, `sessionId`, or dates.

```json
{
  "name": "Morning Schedule",
  "maximumPeriod": 6,
  "periodLength": 45,
  "periodGap": 5,
  "startingTime": "09:00 AM",
  "type": "Automatic",
  "weekOff": ["Sunday"],
  "isCourse": true
}
```

**GET /timeTable**

Lists all structures. Dates/course/session are only on `courseMappings[]`.

Unmapped → `courseMappings: []`.

query.description: Optional — filter structures mapped to this course

request.description:
**GET /timeTable/all_name**

Restored FE endpoint. Returns structures (with periods + matching courseMappings[]).

Optional query: courseId, sessionId.

Example: /timeTable/all_name?courseId=45

**GET /timeTable/structureMappings**

Flat structure + course-mapping rows for printing a table (no periods).

### Query (all optional)
| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `courseId` | Filter by course |
| `sessionId` | Filter by session |
| `timeTableNameId` | Filter by structure |
| `timetableStructureCourseMapperId` | Filter by mapping PK |

### Response `data[]`
`timetableStructureCourseMapperId`, `timeTableNameId`, `structureName`, `maximumPeriod`, `periodLength`, `periodGap`, `startingTime`, `weekOff`, `courseId`, `courseName`, `courseCode`, `sessionId`, `sessionName`, `startingDate`, `endingDate`

**GET /timeTable/single?timeTableNameId=**

One structure with periods + `courseMappings[]`.

**POST /timeTable/courseMapping**

Binds structure → course + session + date window.
Returns `timetableStructureCourseMapperId` for routine create.

**Unique:** `(timeTableNameId, courseId, sessionId)`

**PATCH /timeTable/structure**

Updates a course mapping by `timetableStructureCourseMapperId`.
Can change structure / course / session / dates.
**POST /timeTable/period** — add one period row to an existing structure.
**PATCH /timeTable** — body is an array of period updates.

**DELETE /timeTable?timeTableCreationId=**

Deletes one period row. Blocked if used in published/active routine.

item.name: routine (/timeTableCreate)
item.description:
Routines keyed by `timetableStructureCourseMapperId` (not `timeTableNameId`).

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| POST | `/timeTableCreate/` | Create routine |
| POST | `/timeTableCreate/clone` | Clone routine |
| GET | `/timeTableCreate/` | List routines by course/session |
| GET | `/timeTableCreate/create` | Structure for section UI |
| PATCH | `/timeTableCreate/create` | Update draft routine |
| POST | `/timeTableCreate/mapping` | Assign cell |
| GET | `/timeTableCreate/mapping` | Mapping list (body) |
| GET | `/timeTableCreate/getRoutine` | Grid: structure → routines[] |
| PATCH | `/timeTableCreate/publish` | Publish |

request.description:
**POST /timeTableCreate/**

Requires `timetableStructureCourseMapperId`. Section must match mapping course+session. Dates inside mapping window.

Do **not** send `timeTableNameId`.

**POST /timeTableCreate/clone**

Clones routine + cells into a new date range (same mapper). Optional `previousDate` closes source routine.
**GET /timeTableCreate/** — optional `courseId`, `sessionId`.
**GET /timeTableCreate/single?courseId=**

item.name: get routine by course and section

request.description:
**GET /timeTableCreate/create** — bootstrap structure/mapper for create UI.
`classSectionTermId` required unless `timeTableType=elective`.

**PATCH /timeTableCreate/create** — update draft routine. Blocked if published.
Optional `timetableStructureCourseMapperId` to switch mapper.

**POST /timeTableCreate/mapping** — single cell.
Cell still needs `timeTableNameId` (structure period FK).
**POST /timeTableCreate/mapping** — copy with `sourceTimeTableMappingId` + `copyTarget` (`nextPeriod` | `nextDay`).
**POST /timeTableCreate/mapping** — multi-slot / combined sections via `slots[]` + `classSectionTermIds`.

**GET /timeTableCreate/mapping**

Note: currently validated from **request body** (`timeTableRoutineId`).
**GET /timeTableCreate/single/mapping?courseId=**
**PATCH /timeTableCreate/mapping** — set cell `timeTableType`.
**PATCH /timeTableCreate/mapping/update-create** — body is a non-empty array; first row needs `timeTableMappingId`.
**DELETE /timeTableCreate/mapping?timeTableMappingId=**
**GET /timeTableCreate/cellData** — combined normal+elective cell UI.
**GET /timeTableCreate/elective?courseId=**
**GET /timeTableCreate/subjectCount?classSectionTermId=**
**PATCH /timeTableCreate/publish?timeTableRoutineId=** — sets `isPublish: true`.
**GET /timeTableCreate/getRoutineByTeacher** — `employeeId`, `courseId`, `sessionId`.
